label: Dims + Facts
info: Runs every 15 min. Syncs dimension tables and reloads fact tables from PostgreSQL OLTP into SQL Server DW.

label: Daily Snapshot
info: Runs daily at 00:05 CST. Captures current inventory state into fact_inventory_snapshots.

Query zones

name: MERGE dim_zones SQL
Query suppliers
func:
msg.payload = 'SELECT id,name,contact_email,rating FROM suppliers WHERE is_active=true ORDER BY created_at';

name: MERGE dim_suppliers SQL
Load product keys
func:
msg.payload = 'SELECT product_key, source_id FROM dim_products WHERE is_current=1';

name: Build productMap → load zone keys
Build zoneMap → load supplier keys
Build supplierMap → TRUNCATE
Query inbound movements
func:
msg.payload = `
SELECT
  i.product_id, i.zone_id, i.received_qty,
  s.supplier_id, s.reference_number,
  s.received_date,
  s.expected_date,
  s.created_at,
  s.received_date AS fact_date,
  CASE WHEN s.received_date IS NOT NULL
    THEN (CAST(s.received_date AS DATE) - CAST(s.created_at AS DATE))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS fulfillment_days,
  s.status
FROM inbound_shipment_items i
JOIN inbound_shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
WHERE i.received_qty > 0 AND s.received_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.received_date
`;
return msg;

name: INSERT inbound facts SQL
Switch to inbound orders SQL
func:
msg.payload = msg.inboundOrderSql || 'SELECT 1';
return msg;

name: Query outbound movements
func:
msg.payload = `
SELECT
  i.product_id, i.zone_id, i.quantity,
  o.order_number,
  o.shipped_at AS fact_date,
  o.status,
  CASE WHEN o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.delivered_at - o.created_at)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS fulfillment_days
FROM outbound_order_items i
JOIN outbound_orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY o.shipped_at
`;
return msg;

name: INSERT outbound facts SQL
Switch to outbound orders SQL
func:
msg.payload = msg.outboundOrderSql || 'SELECT 1';
return msg;

name: Query adjustments
func:
msg.payload = `
SELECT
  a.product_id, a.zone_id, a.qty_change,
  a.reason, a.created_at AS fact_date
FROM stock_adjustments a
ORDER BY a.created_at
`;
return msg;
